question: Q69 allows the server's own numeric wait hint.  Is the wording at frontend/src/features/simulation/SimulationPanel.tsx:934 still wrong?
why: the sink renders a sentence this app builds, not a server body (sink cite)
the sentence is chosen by the server's own named code and carries its status
where the server stated a wait, the number is passed through as the server's (约 N 毫秒后再试); where it did not, the screen says 服务器没说要等多久 rather than inventing one -- that is the Q68 line held
the only reachable busy refusal for this panel is GENERATION_STORE_BUSY on POST /journeys/{id}/replans, and that code IS a key in the wording table, so the wait arm is taken
no_ticket_because: HYDRATION_STORE_BUSY carries the same retry_after_ms and has no key here, but this panel never calls POST /api/v1/catalog-hydrations (method census below), and that door's wait is honoured on the destination-preparation screen.  Naming a missing key that no call site can reach would be an invented ticket.
